name: llama-modchip

platforms.note: Prebuilt x86_64 binaries for AVX2 and for AVX-512 with VBMI and VNNI, or built from source, which also covers ARM64 such as Graviton3
MinGW-w64 UCRT64 build of the patched engine, from windows/build_patched_engine.ps1
Apple silicon; apple-silicon/setup.sh builds the patched engine with Metal, which runs FRACTAL_64 on the GPU

MSVC and CUDA build from the -Cuda switch of windows/build_patched_engine.ps1. install.sh builds no GPU engine, and the CUDA and Vulkan binaries windows/AVVIA_MODCHIP.bat downloads for standard GGUFs are mainline llama.cpp's

install.windows: git clone https://github.com/synchopate/llama-modchip && cd llama-modchip && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File windows\build_patched_engine.ps1

note: A llama.cpp fork for MoE models on the CPU. Since 3.0 its own quant types have IDs mainline llama.cpp does not register, FRACTAL_64 (type 44, 3.75 bpw, CPU and Metal) and VQ3_64 (type 45, 3.00 bpw, fastest on x86-64 AVX-512 VBMI, with AVX2, NEON and scalar paths). Standard GGUFs still load, and its MaxQ releases use only standard types. A Linux source build with GGML_CUDA or GGML_VULKAN adds a GPU backend that leaves types 44 and 45 to the CPU, while install.sh and the prebuilt binaries are CPU only. The installer keeps the server in the clone's workspace/bin, not on PATH, and starts it on port 8789; the JSON API is llama-server's, and the bundled SSE gateway on 8787 adds the Anthropic messages endpoint.
